Segnala offerta di lavoro Ecolab is seeking a Marketing Manager to help our customers meet their goals, differentiate Ecolab from our competition, and impact the achievement of our aggressive growth targets. What’s In It For You The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best What You Will Do Support sales growth, customer retention and profitability of the business within the business platform by supporting strategic planning and execution of marketing programs. Drive marketing efforts of existing products. Work across regions to drive global innovation Provide Ecolab sales force with leadership and marketing support, including sales tools, training, competitive intelligence and actionable reporting Develop in-depth customer and market knowledge. Communicate market needs and opportunities. Develop short and long-term strategies and plans for demand generation, on-going market research, customer needs assessment, sales and inventory forecasting, and customer and sales history analysis. Execute marketing strategies, programs, and pricing strategies which will meet profit objectives for the business unit. Assist in developing sales and customer training programs and sales tools to support the sales force in response to customer and competitive needs. Provide competitive intelligence to the field sales teams to counter competitive offers. Stay current on market standards, trends and practices and understand impact on Ecolab product line and business. Lead cross functional teams, as needed, to deliver project results. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of professional experience or MBA in Marketing with 4 years of experience Proficient with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and the Internet Preferred Qualifications Business-to-business marketing experience Previous life science or pharma experience Ability to relate to influential people and complex organizational structures; strong interpersonal and relationship building skills Strategic thinker with the ability to connect evolving market trends, customer needs, regional specificities, and company capabilities into actionable growth opportunities. Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization Demonstrated initiative and leadership skills; setting vision and strategy, planning, critical thinking, orchestrating cross-functionally, overseeing multiple project elements and proven track record of results Effective oral and written communication skills, organizational skills, good attention to detail and use of sound judgment in a fast-paced environment are essential Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage. Ability to travel within Europe and internationally as required to support global and regional priorities. Must have demonstrated initiative and ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks About Ecolab At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world. Ecolab’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right. Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history. Compensation Range The annual pay range for this position is 75,300 - 113,100. This position is eligible for annual bonus Benefits Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families. Click here to see our benefits. Collective Agreement Information (Italy) In Italy, Ecolab applies the National Collective Labour Agreement for the Chemical Industry (CCNL Industria Chimica). title: Italy Regional Marketing Campaign Manager
motivazione: Italy Regional Marketing Campaign Manager in HP (stampa 3D): campagne integrate digital, email, ABM ed eventi, budget e piano a tre mesi, lead e demand generation con CRM: è il tuo mestiere (+300% lead in Dimhora, budget 400k). Gap: chiedono 10 anni di esperienza (ne hai circa 6-8), una multinazionale e viaggi almeno al 50% del tempo, un peso reale sulla vita quotidiana.
testo_completo: Italy Regional Marketing Campaign Manager Description - Job Summary HP Additive Manufacturing (AM) Solutions is leading the transformation of how industries approach production and design. Leveraging our cutting-edge Multi Jet Fusion, Industrial Filament and Metal Jet 3D printing technologies, we empower businesses to produce high-quality, cost-effective parts with unmatched speed and precision. From rapid prototyping to full-scale production, our solutions enable innovation and help companies stay competitive in a fast-evolving market. We are looking for an Italy Regional Campaign Manager to accelerate HP’s Additive Manufacturing Solutions team toward its ambitious goals. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, agile business within HP Inc. We seek candidates who thrive in dynamic settings and are passionate about creating impactful marketing strategies that empower our channel partners and who can travel at least 50% of the time. The Italy Campaign Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns to drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversions. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong project management skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams. Responsibilities Lead localized marketing plans and programs based on the global strategy to achieve regional 3D Solutions revenue, operating profit, market share, marketing-qualified leads, and ROI. Translate global marketing strategies into actionable regional plans , including developing and managing marketing budgets. Conduct market research to understand local customer behavior, preferences, and trends, ensuring campaigns resonate with target audiences. Develop and maintain a three-month rolling country-level marketing plan and campaign budget , ensuring efficient resource allocation. Collaborate with sales and cross-functional teams to align campaign strategies with business objectives and ensure seamless execution. Design and implement integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including digital, social media, email, ABM, and events. Define goals and KPIs to measure the success and business impact of marketing plans; monitor, analyze, and report campaign performance, providing data-driven insights and optimization recommendations. Lead the design of customer buying journeys and touchpoint plans , leveraging paid and owned media channels to maximize awareness and achieve marketing goals. Drive digital marketing transformation , applying advanced knowledge of new digital capabilities and touchpoints to strengthen market position. Ensure compliance with local laws and regulations, including data protection and advertising standards, across all marketing activities. Education & Experience Recommended Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline Equivalent work experience or demonstrated competence may be considered in lieu of formal education. Minimum 10 years of professional experience , preferably in segment marketing, channel marketing, partner marketing, or a related field. Proven expertise in lead and demand generation , including planning, ABM, CRM, nurturing, ROI analysis, marketing effectiveness, Digital Marketing and event management. Knowledge & Skills Content creation proficiency : Ability to craft compelling email copy, event blurbs, social media posts, landing page content, and promotional assets. Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills : Comfortable interfacing with all levels of management, cross-functional teams, external customers, channel partners, and vendors. Analytical mindset : Skilled in interpreting data to drive informed decision-making and optimize marketing performance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Italian Business Development Business Marketing Business To Business Customer Relationship Management Data Analysis Demand Generation Digital Marketing Go-to-Market Strategy Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Market Research Marketing Marketing Communications Marketing Management Marketing Strategies Product Marketing Project Management Social Media Thought Leadership Cross-Org Skills Effective Communication Results Orientation Learning Agility Digital Fluency Customer Centricity Compensation and benefits The base pay range for this role is € 63.350,00 to € 99.850,00 annually with additional cash compensation opportunities in the form of annual cash incentive bonuses. Pay varies by job-related skills, effort, responsibility, working conditions, experience and work location. Additionally, HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including: Supplemental insurance policies Employee Stock Purchase Plan Business Travel Accident Insurance Employee Assistance Program Tickets Restaurant The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Disclaimer This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. Job - Marketing Schedule - Full time Shift - No shift premium (Italia) Travel - 50% Relocation - No Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) - HP, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and prospective employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, age, disability, or status as a protected veteran, marital status, familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, uniformed service status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable national, federal, state, and local law(s). Please be assured that you will not be subject to any adverse treatment if you choose to disclose the information requested. This information is provided voluntarily. The information obtained will be kept in strict confidence. For more information, review HP’s EEO Policy or read about your rights as an applicant under the law here: “ Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal "

title: Field Marketing Manager (all genders)
motivazione: Field Marketing Manager Italia in HRS (SaaS per i viaggi aziendali), Milano ibrido: strategia locale, demand generation, email ed eventi, partnership con la stampa e le associazioni, con ROI misurato. È centrato su marketing B2B e pipeline, le tue aree forti, e il master richiesto lo stai finendo. Gap: chiedono 2 anni in SaaS o travel B2B e un network consolidato con stampa e associazioni del settore viaggi, oltre a Salesforce Marketing Cloud. RAL 55-65k.
testo_completo: ABOUT HRS HRS is the global leader in business travel intelligence. Our AI-native Copilot and Connect Platform transforms fragmented travel, payment, and compliance data into real-time decisions — saving enterprises millions and giving CFOs, procurement teams, and travel managers the control they need. 1B+ Business travel transactions processed annually 3,500+ Enterprise clients across 55 countries 35+ Years building the global travel ecosystem AI-native Copilot & Connect Platform — built for enterprise scale MISSION & IMPACT Mission As Field Marketing Manager Italy, you are responsible for building brand visibility and driving regional growth in the Italian market. You turn global marketing strategy into localized campaigns, events, and partnerships that resonate with Italian B2B audiences and generate qualified pipeline for the sales team. Impact You fuel HRS's growth in Italy by positioning HRS as the leader in B2B travel SaaS. Through targeted campaigns, high-impact events, and strong media and industry relationships, you create demand, accelerate pipeline, and bring local market insights back into global marketing and product roadmaps. What you'll own: Local Market Strategy - Develop a deep understanding of the dynamics of the Italian B2B travel market. - Build and run localized marketing strategies that resonate with regional audiences and align with global objectives. - Influence global marketing and product roadmaps with insights from the Italian market. Campaigns & Demand Generation - Lead regional digital, email, and event-based campaigns that generate leads and drive customer engagement. - Partner with the global Growth Marketing team on targeted demand generation and performance marketing. - Work with the global Product Marketing team to localize product launches, messaging, and content into compelling local stories. Events, Media & Partnerships - Organize and manage trade shows, webinars, and industry events, and represent HRS at key events to build client and partner relationships. - Build relationships with local press, media, and industry associations to grow HRS's brand presence. - Set up strategic partnerships with local travel organizations, influencers, and stakeholders to open up co-marketing and sponsorship opportunities. Performance & Reporting - Track the performance of every initiative using analytics tools to measure ROI and optimize strategies. - Report insights and recommendations to the VP Marketing & Channel Sales of the region. Who you are: - 5+ years of marketing experience, including at least 2 years in SaaS and/or the B2B travel industry. - Proven track record of developing and running localized marketing campaigns with measurable results. - An established network within the Italian media, press, and travel industry associations. - Strong collaboration skills in a matrix organization, working effectively with both global and local stakeholders. - Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to adapt content and messaging for the local market. - Hands-on experience with marketing tools such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Outreach, Google Analytics, and social media platforms. - A strategic mindset combined with the ability to execute on tactical details. - Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (Master's preferred). - Fluent Italian is mandatory, and proficient English is required for global collaboration. Our Hiring Process Recruiter Call -> Hiring Manager -> Panel Interview -> Bar Raiser The market is ready. The platform is built. Now we need the voice to bring it to Italy. Italian enterprises are actively looking for smarter ways to manage travel, spend, and compliance — and HRS has built the AI-native platform to deliver it. A genuinely differentiated story Our AI Copilot and Connect Platform isn't a feature add-on. It's a new operating layer for enterprise travel and payments — a story worth telling, and one that stands up to scrutiny. Real ownership You own the Italian market's marketing agenda end to end, from strategy to events to results, with the backing of global Product and Growth Marketing teams. 35 years of infrastructure, startup urgency The credibility and global reach of an established enterprise player with the ownership culture of a company still building its best chapter. Impact you can measure Every campaign, event, and partnership you run feeds directly into pipeline and growth in one of HRS's most strategic markets. Ready to put HRS on the map in Italy? Apply Now! Join HRS to shape the future of business travel and meetings, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. €55K – €65K

title: Brand Lead Consumer Healthcare - Milan
motivazione: Brand Lead Consumer Healthcare in Opella (Milano, 2 giorni da casa): strategia di marca, campagne integrate, budget e team, per brand di salute e benessere. Hai marketing, budget e leadership, ma chiedono 8 anni di brand building in OTC o FMCG, 3 da manager di brand e lanci di prodotto, mestiere di brand management che non hai fatto. I gap sono biografici (settore, anni); RAL 62-82k.
testo_completo: Salary Range: €62,000.00 - €82,666.66 All Compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. ‎ You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As a Brand Lead, you’ll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human. About the job As a Brand Lead, you will own the strategy, growth and execution of one or more of Opella’s leading brands in Italy. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, driving brand performance while identifying new opportunities to accelerate growth, innovation and consumer engagement. In this role, you will work across functions, influence key stakeholders and help shape the future of self-care in a dynamic and fast-evolving environment. You will have the opportunity to make a visible impact on brands that reach millions of consumers every day. Lead initiatives that advance our brands and strengthen our reputation worldwide. Mentor and uplift emerging talent while pushing your own growth and influence. Put purpose into practice — embedding sustainability, access and social impact into every decision. Model the challenger mindset: question complexity, act with integrity and make things radically simple. Help shape a culture that’s ambitious, collaborative and serious about recognition and belonging. Main responsibilities Define and implement the marketing strategy, brand plans and activation roadmap for assigned brands. Drive sustainable business growth through effective portfolio management, consumer insights and innovation initiatives. Lead the development and execution of integrated campaigns across media, digital and customer-facing channels. Own brand performance, including budget management, investment prioritization and delivery of commercial objectives. Monitor market trends, consumer behavior and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and inform decision-making. Collaborate closely with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Digital, Global Marketing and external partners to deliver impactful initiatives. Lead and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. About you Proven experience of at least 8 years in marketing, building and growing consumer-facing brands within Consumer Healthcare, OTC, FMCG, beauty, dermocosmetics or related sectors. At least 3 years in a managerial, team leadership role, ideally as Senior Brand Manager / Brand Lead.Strong experience translating consumer and market insights into successful marketing strategies and execution plans. Demonstrated success leading product launches, innovation projects or portfolio expansion initiatives. Solid business acumen with experience managing budgets and making data-driven decisions. Strong leadership, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across local, regional and global teams. Digital-first mindset with a good understanding of consumer engagement, media activation and modern marketing approaches. Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken are required. Location: Milan Hybrid working policy: 2 days per week remote working. Salary range: starting base salary 62.000€ This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella. About Us Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com. Opella values diversity in all its forms and is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone can belong and excel. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. #LI-HYBRID
